blocks.text: Simple social media scheduling for creators and small businesses

Buffer has built its reputation on doing social media management simply and well. While competitors pile on features, Buffer maintains a clean interface that makes scheduling, publishing, and analyzing social content accessible to anyone - not just social media managers.

The scheduling workflow is frictionless. Create a post, choose which platforms to publish on, customize per platform if needed, and schedule or queue. Buffer handles optimal timing, format differences, and cross-posting logistics. For small teams posting 3-5 times per week per platform, this simplicity is perfect.

Buffer's analytics provide the insights that matter without overwhelming dashboards. See which posts performed best, when your audience is most active, and how your following is growing - actionable data without the noise.
Schedule posts across Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, and more
Visual calendar view of all scheduled and published content
Post performance, audience insights, and growth tracking
AI helps generate post ideas and repurpose content
Create a landing page for your social media profiles
Buffer proves that social media tools do not need to be complicated. For small teams that just need to post consistently and see what is working, Buffer is the right level of tool without the bloat.
Our team can integrate Buffer into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
